BUG TITLE: Rider and seller accounts can access the buyer area of CampusKart without registering as a buyer
ENVIRONMENT: HP EliteBook, Windows 11, CampusKart in Google Chrome. Redmi Note 13, Android, Chrome for Android. Glo mobile network. Tested 16 September 2026.
PRECONDITIONS: A rider account exists with no linked buyer account. A seller account exists with no linked buyer account. User is logged out.
STEPS TO REPRODUCE: 1. Open Google Chrome and go to https://campuskart.site. 2. Click Login. 3. Enter the rider account credentials and log in. 4. Navigate to the buyer area again. 9. Observe whether buyer features load. 10. Repeat steps 3 to 9 a second time from a fresh browser session.
EXPECTED RESULT: A rider account should only grant access to rider features. A seller account should only grant access to seller features. ACTUAL RESULT: Both the rider account and the seller account load the buyer area without any separate registration. No access-denied message is shown. Buyer features such as the cart, buyer dashboard, and buyer messaging are reachable from a rider session and from a seller session.
